Close-up of piece 1: 'TWO SEASONS' title and 'I see black clouds rolling in' verse.
Turned copy, now upright. Close-up of piece 2: 'Ah, now I see the clouds / Are blowing away' ... 'I can feel my heart torn'.
Turned copy, now upright. Close-up of piece 3: 'adrift on the sea all alone' ... 'Try to forget all I've said'.

cards.words_note: Typed words match the three pieces. But the typing repeats itself: all three pieces typed once from the overview photo, then typed again after '---' from the close-ups, so a buyer sees the song twice.
cards.name_note: Title written on the sheet: TWO SEASONS.
cards.other_problems: Typed words are doubled (same pieces typed twice). Summary 'loose sheet' undersells it - it is three torn notepad pieces. Both turned photos (3 and 4) are the right way up.
